findings.msg: StateLabel uses variant=pull request, in Figma, not in docs
findings.fix: Use a variant that ships in code, or add pull request to code and docs first

findings.msg: StateLabel colour set to #8a5cf5 by hand instead of bgColor/done-emphasis
findings.fix: Reset the override so it uses bgColor/done-emphasis again

findings.msg: fgColor/accent on bgColor/default is 4.33:1 in dark dimmed
findings.fix: A Primer token pair, not a screen mistake: raise fgColor/accent in dark dimmed

findings.msg: “#4810 merged last week by laura-g” is 1.87:1 on #ffffff, needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Use fgColor/muted (or darker) instead of #b8bec6

findings.msg: fgColor/link on bgColor/default is 4.33:1 in dark dimmed
findings.fix: A Primer token pair, not a screen mistake: raise fgColor/link in dark dimmed

findings.msg: StateLabel uses size=normal, in Figma, not in docs
findings.fix: Use a size that ships in code, or add normal to code and docs first

findings.msg: InlineMessage uses variant=unavailable, in Figma, not in docs
findings.fix: Use a variant that ships in code, or add unavailable to code and docs first

findings.msg: “marta-ruiz” passes in light but fails in 5 of 8 other modes (worst: 1:1 in dark high contrast)
findings.fix: The background is set by hand and doesn't switch with the theme; bind it to a token

findings.msg: “Looks good. Can we check the 24px target size ag” passes in light but fails in 5 of 8 other modes (worst: 1:1 in dark high contrast)
findings.fix: The background is set by hand and doesn't switch with the theme; bind it to a token

findings.msg: “Frame” background is #ffffff by hand
findings.fix: Bind it to bgColor/default (or the right bg token) so it switches in dark mode

findings.msg: Pagehead is deprecated in Primer's docs
findings.fix: Use PageHeader

findings.msg: TabNav is deprecated in Primer's docs
findings.fix: Use UnderlineNav

findings.msg: Button is detached from the library
findings.fix: Swap it back to a Button instance so library updates reach it

findings.msg: fgColor/danger on bgColor/default is 4.02:1 in dark dimmed
findings.fix: A Primer token pair, not a screen mistake: raise fgColor/danger in dark dimmed

findings.msg: MergeBanner (old) isn't in the library: its main component was deleted or never published
findings.fix: Replace it with a library component (InlineMessage or Banner)

findings.msg: SegmentedControl uses size=medium, missing in code
findings.fix: Use a size that ships in code, or add medium to code and docs first

findings.msg: Button is 24px tall; its medium size is 32px
findings.fix: Use a size option (e.g. size=small) instead of resizing it

findings.msg: “Danger zone” passes in light but fails in 5 of 8 other modes (worst: 1.06:1 in dark dimmed)
findings.fix: The text is set by hand and doesn't switch with the theme; bind it to a token

findings.msg: fgColor/default on diffBlob/deletion/bgColor/line is 2.43:1 in dark high contrast (+1 modes)
findings.fix: A Primer token pair, not a screen mistake: raise fgColor/default in dark dimmed, dark high contrast

findings.msg: fgColor/muted on diffBlob/deletion/bgColor/line is 1.15:1 in dark (+4 modes)
findings.fix: A Primer token pair, not a screen mistake: raise fgColor/muted in dark, dark dimmed, dark high contrast, dark protanopia deuteranopia, dark tritanopia

findings.msg: “Danger zone” uses #1f2328 by hand, the same value as fgColor/default
findings.fix: Bind it to fgColor/default so theme and dark mode reach it

findings.msg: “Danger row” padding is 13px, off Primer's spacing scale
findings.fix: Use 12px (a base/size token)

findings.msg: diffBlob/deletion/bgColor/line isn't in @primer/primitives
findings.fix: Use a token code ships, or add diffBlob/deletion/bgColor/line to primitives

findings.msg: Label 'On' does not describe the setting being toggled.
findings.fix: Replace with a descriptive label such as 'Allow auto-merge'.

findings.msg: Label 'On' does not describe the setting being toggled.
findings.fix: Replace with a descriptive label such as 'Automatically delete head branch'.

findings.msg: Uses danger variant for a "Save changes" action which is not destructive.
findings.fix: Use primary or default variant instead of danger.

findings.msg: Icon link‑external contradicts the delete action; delete should use trash icon.
findings.fix: Replace link‑external icon with trash (octicon trash) or remove the icon.
